name: Prove Your Worth
summary: At the Sepulcher, Prove Your Worth begins Dalar Dawnweaver's campaign against the worgen of Silverpine. The Forsaken seek a path south through human and dwarven lands, but feral worgen threaten the road. Their presence leads back to Archmage Arugal.

sections.title: Securing the Southern Corridor
sections.body: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her dreadlord lieutenant, Varimathras, seek to secure the lands south of Tirisfal Glades, including human and dwarven enclaves. Silverpine Forest lies in their path, but the route is dangerous. Feral Moonrage worgen prowl the pine-covered hills, threatening Forsaken supply lines and forward bases.

sections.title: Arugal's Blight
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver says the worgen came through the work of Arugal, a disgraced former mage of Dalaran. During the Scourge invasion, Arugal unleashed otherworldly worgen upon Silverpine. He has since claimed Shadowfang Keep, while his feral creations roam the forest. Before Dalar trusts soldiers with a deeper inquiry into Arugal's sorcery, recruits must prove their fighting skill against the nearest Moonrage Whitescalps.

faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver is a Forsaken mage at the Sepulcher. He leads efforts against magical threats in Silverpine, especially Archmage Arugal and his feral worgen pack.

faq.q: Where are the Moonrage Whitescalps located?
faq.answer: The Moonrage Whitescalps prowl the woods and ruined homesteads of central Silverpine, just off the main road down the hill from the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about worgen in Silverpine?
faq.answer: The Horde needs Silverpine Forest as a route from the Undercity to the southern lands. Lady Sylvanas and Varimathras seek safe passage south, and the worgen packs threaten that route.

faq.q: What is Arugal's connection to these creatures?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal summoned the extradimensional worgen to fight the Scourge while he served Dalaran. The beasts turned wild, and guilt drove Arugal mad before he withdrew to Shadowfang Keep to foster the curse.

faq.q: What happens after proving your worth to Dalar?
faq.answer: After you prove your combat skill by slaying the Whitescalps, Dalar Dawnweaver enlists you in his campaign against Arugal's influence through the multi-part chain called Arugal's Folly.

faq.q: Is the Alliance involved in this quest?
aliases: can alliance do prove your worth
faq.answer: No. Dalar Dawnweaver gives this to the Horde at the Forsaken outpost of the Sepulcher.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help clear Silverpine to secure the Undercity's borders and remove threats left by Dalaran's failures.
As a mage, you can see the danger of reckless conjuration in Dalar Dawnweaver's mission and Arugal's calamity.
As Horde, you help secure a clear military road through Silverpine toward southern Lordaeron.
